title: NTN for an AOP or company
description: Registration for an association of persons or a company.

questions.prompt_ru: Kaun si entity register ho rahi hai?

steps.title: Read section 181
steps.detail: An AOP or company registers under section 181 of the Income Tax Ordinance, 2001. Use the entity name on the formation papers.
steps.detail_ru: AOP ya company Income Tax Ordinance, 2001 ki section 181 ke tehat register hoti hai. Formation papers wala entity name istemal karein.

steps.title: File the registration on IRIS
steps.detail: The federal application is on IRIS. Provincial offices do not replace that step.
steps.detail_ru: Federal darkhwast IRIS par hai. Provincial daftar is step ki jagah nahi lete.
